<observations>
Date: May 4, 2026
* 🔴 User wants modern island with integrated sink, matte black faucet, and pull-out spray; contractor quote $18,400; fixture deadline May 10.
* 🟡 Selected $515 sink model; scheduled plumbing with GreenPipe Co.
* 🟢 User has a dog named Bella.

Date: May 7, 2026
* 🔴 User prefers brushed nickel cabinet hardware; approved waterfall edge countertop ($4,200) and revised contractor quote $21,250.
* 🟡 Selected $275 RGB lighting kit and herringbone subway tile ($1,150); set backsplash deadline May 12.
* 🟢 User has a cat named Whiskers.

Date: May 10, 2026
* 🔴 User added pull-out pantry and pot-filler faucet ($420); set firm appliance deadline May 18.
* 🟡 Selected "Arctic Fog" low-VOC paint ($45/gal), ChillBox CB-300 under-counter fridge ($1,120), and self-watering herb kit ($85).
* 🟢 Partner prefers matte white walls; teenage daughter visiting.

Date: May 13, 2026
* 🔴 User selected Calacatta Gold quartz island ($4,750) and set rule: send photos before opening walls.
* 🟡 Sourced brushed nickel handles ($12), pet-care kit for cat Luna ($85), and VinoVault wine cooler ($920).
* 🟢 User set lighting approval milestone for May 16.

Date: May 17, 2026
* 🔴 User selected matte white Oakridge LunaSeries cabinets ($1,850 ea, delivery June 5) and Arctic Pearl glass tile; out of town May 24–26 (demo paused to May 27).
* 🟡 Filed plumbing permit PR-2026-517; scheduled CityPower inspection for May 20.
* ✅ Uploaded revised 3-D kitchen model showing cabinets, backsplash, and coffee station.

Date: May 21, 2026
* 🔴 User selected RiverEdge quartz countertop ($3,200, delivery June 8) and EcoTemp Pro thermostat (install June 15); appliance allowance is $6,300.
* 🟡 Added ChillBox C12 wine cooler and Nimbus brushed nickel pendants ($89 ea); scheduled plumbing inspection for May 28.
* ✅ Uploaded revised floor plan and sent summary email with upcoming June milestones.
</observations>

<current-task>
- Primary: Managing kitchen remodel selections, upcoming inspections (CityPower May 20), and scheduling milestones (demo May 27, quartz delivery June 8).
- Secondary: Tracking appliance selections ahead of the May 18 deadline.
</current-task>

<suggested-response>
"I've updated all your kitchen remodel selections, finishes, and upcoming milestone dates. Would you like to review any remaining appliance choices before the May 18 deadline?"
</suggested-response>
